name: @pipeworx/mcp-iso

tools.name: search_standards
tools.description: Search the full ISO catalogue (~all deliverables) by keyword across reference, title and abstract, with optional filters. Returns reference, title, status, abstract snippet, committee and the iso.org link. Use to find standards on a topic ("supply chain security", "medical device risk").

query.description: Keywords matched against title + abstract + reference (full-text).

ics.description: Filter by ICS classification code prefix, e.g. "35.030" (IT security).

type.description: Filter by deliverable type: IS, TR, TS, PAS, Guide, …

tools.name: get_standard
tools.description: Full record for one ISO standard by number ("27001") or reference ("ISO/IEC 27001:2022"): title, abstract, status, edition, publication date, ICS, committee, the supersession chain, the correct iso.org page, and a best-effort live price. The reliable lookup (resolves any standard via its catalogue id).

number.description: ISO number or reference, any form: "27001", "ISO 9001", "ISO-9001", "ISO9001", "ISO/IEC 42001", "ISO 9001:2015". (The `reference` arg is also accepted.)

tools.name: compliance_catalog
tools.description: Curated catalogue of the compliance-relevant ISO standards (ISMS/27000, privacy, AI/42000, quality, continuity, risk) → ISO number, family and summary. Static name→number resolver; pass a number to get_standard for the live record.

tools.name: open_data_files
tools.description: URLs for the ISO Open Data bulk files (deliverables metadata, ICS classification, technical committees), ODC-By 1.0. The deliverables file is what backs this pack. Use to ingest the full dataset yourself.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-iso forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the iso pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
